caption:
A full day cheering on the grandkids, and Koko's back is stiff. No running required.

Standing on hard ground, perching on low folding chairs, leaning on fences and hours in the car between games add up. It isn't strenuous, but staying in one position often leaves backs stiff.

Bring a chair with a backrest, walk a lap of the field at every break, and carry eskies and bags close to your body.

Back pain spreading into a leg, numbness or weakness is worth an assessment. Bladder or bowel changes or numbness around the groin need urgent medical care. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
